title: Mythic Zombies
description:
Mythic Zombies is getting a complete overhaul. While it will remain a round-based zombie survival game at its core, almost every system has been rebuilt from the ground up.

Expect brand-new maps, a much deeper progression system, and far more replayability. After every round, you'll choose from a selection of powerful upgrades that shape your run, earn Ascension Points for surviving longer to improve those upgrades during each run, and level up through a full XP progression system that unlocks new content as you play.

This isn't just an update—it's a completely new Mythic Zombies experience.

We don't have a release date to share yet, so if you're thinking about buying the game, please do so with the understanding that the current version will be changing significantly in the near future.

The version available today is a classic round-based zombies experience. The upcoming overhaul keeps that core gameplay intact but introduces roguelike progression, giving every run meaningful choices, unique upgrade combinations, and much greater replayability. If you enjoy round-based zombies with roguelike elements, that's the experience we're building toward. 

Warning! Anything Below is about the game as it stands right now

Please also note a controller will work with this game but only once in a game. it will not work in menus.

Mythic Zombies is a round-based zombie game, where you and up to 7 mates (8-player co-op) are tasked with surviving as many rounds as you can of never-ending zombies and buying Doors, Guns and power-ups to help you in your task. Each round will become harder and harder as you climb the levels, with more zombies spawning. 

 

Free DLC and no microtransactions mean you will never be left behind. That's Right, We will be supporting the game with free DLC, and we will never have any Microtransactions. 

But Why?

 As Gamers, we understand that paying for a game, even just to play any DLC, is truly frustrating and can sometimes leave people behind and stop them from playing with their buddies. This is why we will support the game with Free Updates and DLC, so we know you can play the way you want to. 

Every map that comes to Mythic Zombies will be 100% Free, We will never charge for maps. We plan to have around 20 maps when the game comes out of early access. 

From Day one, Mythic Zombies will support Single-player, LAN And Online, so play with your mates. Sit back and relax with single-player. You don't even need to be connected online to play single-player, so just like the old days, load up the game and start killing zombies. 

Within the first six months the game has been out we plan to have all zombie and player characters changed as well as full mod support, XP system and guns added. We also plan to update a lot of our 3D models as well.

With each update, we plan to add at least one map and gun.
description_short: Take on Zombies solo or with 7 friends. We're rebuilding from the ground up and updating for free this year 2024. Get ready for intense, endless action against waves of zombies
